findings.title: E2E Supabase image cache is not a reliable cold-start path: a cache hit loads, then `supabase start` still fails before Playwright
findings.note: new at 6b7aa1a5: e2e.yml:87-103 restores /tmp/supabase-images.tar and `docker load`s it on a cache hit, and only saves the tar after a successful `supabase start` (:133-140). On run 41598757709 (2026-11-03, develop tree 2a8b6abf) steps 7-8 (restore + load) both succeeded and step 10 `Start Supabase` failed, so Playwright never ran; the two prior E2E runs also failed. The fixed key `supabase-images-${runner.os}-2.107.0-v1` (:91) never invalidates when the CLI's image set changes, and the save step cannot repair an incomplete cache because it is skipped on a hit; the same job also warns that DOCKERHUB_USERNAME/DOCKERHUB_TOKEN are not provisioned, so any cache miss still falls back to the anonymous pull limit. The new ubuntu-24.04 pin (:46) is sound for WebKit, but the cache does not yet deliver a green E2E. Fix: verify every image ref the pinned CLI needs with `docker image inspect` before start, rebuild/save on a miss or partial set, bump the key with the CLI/image set, and fail the cache step loudly rather than retrying an incomplete cache. Cross-domain: the CI area records the same red required check as CI-P1-005.
